fields.title: 📖 The Ṭāghūt is to be rejected
fields.body:
🖋️ **Allah ʿazza wa jalla:**

> ***“Allah rebukes those who claim to believe but want to have themselves judged by the Ṭāghūt, although they were commanded to reject him.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Muḥākamah to the Ṭāghūt is no side matter. The foundation is Barāʾah from the false judgment and submission to Allah’s Ḥukm.

immutable.source: 📝 aṭ-Ṭabarī und Ibn Kathīr, Tafsīr zu Sūrah an-Nisāʾ 4:60.
